items.title: Extract the storyDir-inside-gitRoot invariant check into one reusable core fn
items.context: worktree.ts:754 and cli-engine.ts:3367 both inline the same relative()+.. escape check. Extract to core (near story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts) as the single source of truth: realpath both sides, violation when rel is empty/absolute/contains a .. segment. Have both existing guards call it so behavior is byte-identical.

happy.desc: helper returns ok when storyDir resolves inside the gitRoot

edge.desc: helper flags a violation when storyDir is a .. sibling of gitRoot (the ClawCreek case)

adversarial.desc: symlinked roots (/var -> /private/var) do not produce a false violation (realpath both sides)

items.title: Add a lattice doctor check reporting storyDir-outside-gitRoot early with remediation
items.context: doctor should detect the violation using the shared fn and print the same remediation text (configure storyDir so story metadata lives inside the gitRoot), so users see it before INIT_CHECK.

items.title: Surface the violation as an early advisory at story_create / session_brief
items.context: Warn early so wrapper-root users learn before investing PLAN work. Decide hard-fail vs warn in PLAN: a hard-fail at story_create would retroactively break existing limping wrapper-root projects (e.g. ClawCreek with 19 live stories).

items.title: Tests covering the invariant fn + doctor + advisory, including a wrapper-root fixture
items.context: Cover: storyDir inside gitRoot (ok); storyDir as a .. sibling of gitRoot (violation, the ClawCreek case); symlinked roots resolved via realpath; no configured gitRoot / plain repo (unchanged).
